title: 8 Days & 7 Nights Yoga Retreat in Ubud Bali
metaTitle: 8 Days Yoga Retreat in Bali Indonesia
metaDescription: Give yourself the best break from your daily chores and settle down to a more contemplative mode through the great art of yoga and meditation under the best 8 days yoga retreat
summary: An 8 days & 7 nights yoga retreat in Ubud with daily pranayama & meditation, Hatha Vinyasa yoga, sound and Reiki healing sessions and Balinese massage treatments.
intro: Our yoga retreat center is located in heart of Bali (Ubud) that has the calm environment that includes private rooms, outdoor swimming pool and an open garden area. Yoga instructors at Bali Yoga School teach authentic and personalised yoga lessons along with detox and de-stress therapies irrespective of your age and experience.

Our teachers possess the ancient knowledge and modern yoga teaching methods to offer classes for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels for yoga. We offer daily detoxification / pranayama class, meditation class, and a Hatha vinyasa flow class.

arrival: Check In – On the Day 1st after 12:00 pm
Check Out – On the last day before 12:00 pm

The best and most convenient way to travel to Bali Yoga School is to take a flight to Denpasar Bali airport. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 km away from our school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to meet you from Denpasar Bali airport and drive to the school.

issues: Intro paragraph 1 speaks of 'the tranquil beach life of Bali' on an Ubud (inland) retreat page and calls it 'the best 8 Days Yoga Retreat' — dropped.
Slug ends in '-2' (8-days-yoga-retreat-in-bali-2) — likely a WordPress duplicate slug.
Inclusion '7 Full-Body Complimentary Balinese Massage' matches the 7 massage slots in the schedule (Days 1–7).
Intro says 'We guarantee you a completely refreshing experience' — unverified claim, not used.
Meal timings list dinner 19:30 – 20:30 but the daily schedule shows dinner at 7:00 pm.
Meal note says 'Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays' while the retreat runs year-round with lunch and dinner on every schedule day and '3 meals a day' in inclusions — verify Sunday meals.
No retreat-specific policies (booking deposit / refund) on this Ubud page, unlike the Uluwatu pages.
Hub /yoga-retreats-in-bali/ says 'vegan meals'; this page says 'vegan/vegetarian'.
Founder section (Yogi Himanshu) contains unverifiable superlatives ('the most honest, hard-working, authentic person we can ever meet') — not extracted.
Page ends with a 'Yoga Retreats in Rishikesh, India – Learn More' cross-sell block (skipped; link target not captured).
